title: HitCycle Coach
description: A Fabric client timing coach for attack cooldown rhythm, sprint discipline, and manual click feedback.
body:
# HitCycle Coach

HitCycle Coach is a Fabric client timing trainer for manual PvP clicks. It shows whether your last attack lined up with Minecraft's cooldown rhythm, plus sprint/use state cues that matter when learning clean hit cycles.

It is built for players who want feedback while practicing, not automation. You still aim, click, move, and time every hit yourself.

## Features

- Attack cooldown readiness bar
- Last-click timing feedback for manual swings
- Sprint and use-state cues for cleaner practice review
- Weapons-only mode for quieter HUD behavior
- Configurable ready threshold, scale, opacity, position, and color
- Mod Menu config screen

## PvP Fairness

HitCycle Coach does not autoclick, aim, rotate, reset sprint, select items, or trigger attacks. It only displays local cooldown and input-state feedback after manual actions.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft: 1.21.11
- Loader: Fabric
- Requires: Fabric API
- Optional: Mod Menu for in-game configuration

## Author

Created by experiment-0011.
